description:
A signal about one request. Evidence, never an approval to train.

Delivered at least once; ``dedup_key`` makes the second delivery a no-op.

created_at.description: When this row was written (UTC, timezone-aware). Freshness is computed from it.
created_at.title: Created At

dedup_key.description: Producer idempotency key; unique per tenant.
dedup_key.title: Dedup Key

event_schema_version.description: Version of the application's event schema that produced this row.
event_schema_version.title: Event Schema Version

request_id.description: Every signal joins to a request.
request_id.title: Request Id

schema_version.description: Version of this row's schema. Bumped on any field change; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the row. Every index query and cost report filters on it.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

title: Feedback
